description: An interactive field guide to Earth-observation satellites: how Earth's equatorial bulge turns an orbit just enough to keep pace with the Sun, so Landsat and Sentinel-2 always pass at mid-morning; the inclination this needs at each altitude, checked against Landsat 1, Landsat 9 and Sentinel-2; how swath width sets the revisit time; and the diffraction limit on image sharpness.
og: Why Landsat crosses the equator at 10:12 every day: sun-synchronous orbits, revisit time and image resolution, interactive and checked against NASA and ESA data.
brand: SUNSYNC — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
